source: PhreshPhish (Dalton et al.), Hannousse & Yahiouche, PhiUSIIL (Prasad & Chandra); CC BY 4.0
split: Fixed SHA256 partitions of registrable domains using bundled Public Suffix List (including private suffixes). Train 60%, selection 15%, governance 10%, final test 15%. External PhreshPhish test domains overlapping development excluded. Smoke domains excluded from all partitions.

policy.selected_on: validation only; maximize phishing recall subject to FPR <= 0.5%

limitations: URL-only structural evidence cannot establish a site is official or safe. Scores are not calibrated probabilities. Abstention is not protection. Historical benchmark sources are not live threat intelligence; domain caps/splits reduce but cannot eliminate collection and campaign bias. False positives and false negatives remain.
